ftbquests.chapter.overhauled_ore_process: The multiplication values for the purification chamber, chemical injection chamber, and chemical crystalizer apply *only* if you begin processing from there. Basically, you cannot multiply these values together, although you can do it for the steps before these.
The most efficient ore processing... for now.

This modpack offers incredibly powerful methods of increasing ore yield per ore chunk, starting at double output and going up to over 25 ingots per ore. Although not strictly necessary, this will be particularly useful to you since it will allow you to get more materials with less EMC cost. Do note that the machines shown on the quest aren't necessarily all the machines that will be required for the whole process.
ftbquests.chapter.overview.questA440BFFA: Mechanical Mastery is an expert-yet-not-horribly-grindy skyblock modpack, focused around automating everything in order to keep progressing. EMC has been completely overhauled, and only raw resources such as ore chunks have EMC, and new "mechanical essences" can be crafted out of these raw materials, with multiple tiers giving exponentially more EMC the more complicated they get. In order to succeed in this modpack, you need to learn how to automate these mechanical essences and gain as much EMC as possible, good luck!
ftbquests.chapter.overview.title: Overview
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest13AA6AFAF9: You have probably already noticed that in this modpack, ores give less than one ingot when regularly smelted. Thankfully, with the pulverizer, you can negate this by getting 1-2 ore dust from each ore chunk!
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest19499868D9: The engineer's hammer is how you will get your first plates and rods. It's not very efficient, though, there must be some better way to do this in the future...
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest19A22A30A2: With these raw resources, it will not be too difficult to make your first power generator: a stirling dynamo. Although far from ideal, it will be of great importance early on.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest1A1486F396: Just like the pulverizer, certain "catalysts" can be used inside the induction smelter to boost primary and secondary output, energy efficiency, and some other things. Check JEI for more info.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest258878D4F8: One great way to get EMC before automation is simply growing trees, since logs contain some EMC.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest2746A3F7A9: You can place special dies on the bottom slot of the multiservo press to change its functionality, such as crafting gears instead of plates. This modpack adds a custom rod die which can be used to make rods from plates.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest2B65C5DE4A: The redstone furnace allows you to smelt things just like a regular furnace can, except it consumes RF instead of fuel.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest2B8F40D351: Clay can be turned into bricks, another important resource for automation and crafting.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest3434FB0FA0: Some items can serve as a "catalyst" inside the pulverizer, increasing primary and secondary output, plus some other modifiers. Check JEI for a list of them.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest387D9ECF1C: The sequential fabricator allows you to automate crafting, you only have to select the recipe and insert the ingredients, then they will be crafted into the output.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest491EB18107: Welcome to this modpack, where your objective is to automate every mechanical crystal. Through this quest book, you will receive many of the basic materials you will need to fulfill this job. Make sure to learn the items first before using them up, no refunds!
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest4AB3B5469D: With the basic EMC link, you can automatically convert items to EMC and vice versa. With them, you can fully automate the production of mechanical essences.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest547050DB11: How do you get invar before having the induction smelter? Easy, pulverize iron and nickel, and craft the dusts together to form invar blend, which you can smelt into invar ingots
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest54983CC37D: With the multiservo press, you can automate what the engineer's hammer does and more, without losing item durability and with a little extra efficiency. You can craft plates and more with it!
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest5B12C19CBD: In order to actually automate stuff, you want an effective way to move items from machine to machine. Hoppers are too slow and filtering with them is too space consuming. Pretty pipes, however, are a great solution early on. If you dont want items to overflow, you need to install stack limiter modules on each output (or get a high extraction module, but we're not there yet).
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest5D6996CC94: Create a basic cobblestone generator to unlock access to some basic resources. REMEMBER: ALWAYS learn the items first before using them!
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest6039A6C800: Pulverize copper and nickel to craft constantan blend, which can be smelted into constantan ingots
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest7A0CB1037E: By crafting some gears and rods together, you managed to craft the first of the mechanical essences! This cube has an EMC value higher than the sum of its parts, so if you can manage to automate it, it will serve as a great EMC source!
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest7DB08AC0D1: The induction smelter can make many alloys that will be valuable in the future.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest7DC5EA1725: Eventually, you will want to power multiple machines with the same dynamos. Use these energy cables to connect your machines and generators together so they can share power with each other.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.quest9BAD2F7D01: EMC links output 1 item per second, yet redstone furnaces and pulverizers take longer than that to process one item. Because of this, you will most likely need one pulverizer and redstone furnace per each raw material needed for automation (copper, iron, aluminum). Remember to trash unwanted byproducts such as slag, or they might stop your machines from working. You can use the stack limiter module to limit how much your machines can accept, which is useful so your one iron pulverizer doesn't consume all your EMC by filling with 64 raw iron.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_1.title: Tier 1: Thermal
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest167C9AF69B: Suddenly, the basic mechanical essence whispers to you, granting you knowledge of various materials, allowing you to transmute them at will.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest1D11484214: You can use industrial hemp for tough fabric and string.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest1F6B599E8A: The pyrolizer is an RF alternative to the coke oven.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest22AE3DD694: The auxiliary cactus removes any EXCESS secondary outputs you may not want.\nIf you don't understand what is meant by "excess", read the next quest
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest2C583C6E7F: You can cook tough fabric into leather
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest2ECECEF6F2: Immersive engineering adds its own set of machines, power generators, and logistics. More importantly, it will be your first source of steel.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest388F7E8E66: Create's mechanical belts allow for transportation of items with customizable speed. Since Pretty Pipes offer some advantages and disadvantages to mechanical belts, this quest is optional.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest3CBA430E4E: Crushing wheels can be used to further increase ore yield.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest3E8161FF2C: Crush bones into bone meal to spawn grass and get seeds for a source of food.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest3F35726F4C: Create a 3x3x3 cube of blast bricks and right click the middle with an engineer's hammer to make a blast furnace, allowing you to turn iron and coke coal into steel and slag. Alternatively, you can use an induction smelter for a heavy RF cost.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest42C45408AC: The magma crucible can, among other things, liquify cobblestone and netherrack into lava. Liquifying netherrack costs less RF and is therefore faster.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest43D3AF6AA4: Too much creosote oil or slag and don't know what to do with it? Craft a nullifier and automatically void all this waste
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest45DC5DB7E7: Bronze can be made in the induction smelter with 3 copper and 1 tin.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest508D237427: The Dye Mixer takes red, green, and yellow dyes, and can mix them into any other dye color. You can get green dye by smelting cactus, and red and yellow from flowers obtained by bone mealing grass.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest58CDD90E19: You can crush netherrack into cinder flour, which can be used as an alternative source of redstone.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest5C0C4A60E6: The lapidary dynamo has a special purpose in this modpack: it accepts mechanical essences and outputs large amounts of RF.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest5F73D5F328: In order to get into create, you will need large quantities of andesite. You can initially get andesite with cobblestone and high covalence dust or quartz, but once you get a mechanical mixer you can get andesite from gravel, flint and lava.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest60D3472A8B: Invar can be made in the induction smelter with 2 iron and 1 nickel.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest619D128105:
Some thermal machines have multiple output slots. For example, the pulverizer has 4 output "buffers". The auxiliary cactus voids EXCESS secondary outputs ONLY if there are no free output slots for them to fill OR there's only enough space for the primary output.
What's the difference? For example, let's say you are pulverizing gravel, which can make sand (primary) with a chance for flint (secondary).
Without the augment, if there's only enough space for sand but the pulverizer "wants" to output 1 sand AND 1 flint, it will STOP working since there isn't enough space to output ALL its contents.
WITH the augment however, if the machine wants to output sand and flint BUT there's only enough space for the sand, it will VOID the flint, and will continue working.
This doesn't really matter for automation, since it will still VOID the EXCESS, so:
TLDR: the machines WILL still produce secondary outputs but WONT stop if they fill with them, so the only difference is that you need make sure to filter when extracting out of the machine.
Yes it does. Read this description if you don't understand
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest62EFBE3479: Create a 3x3x3 cube of coke bricks and right click the middle with an engineer's hammer to create a coke oven, allowing you to (slowly) turn coal into coal coke and creosote oil
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest638EE765C8: By washing soul sand with water, you can obtain large amounts of quartz.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest662DE7460C: The mechanical press offers an RF-free way of converting ingots into plates.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest6A69E64613: Integral components can be inserted to thermal machines to increase their base values.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest6DB9CDAA51: Encased fans serve a variety of purposes, from pushing/pulling entities, to fuel-free smelting and item washing. Remember: you can learn more from most Create machines by hovering over them and holding "W".
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest7516EFF9A2: With creosote oil, you can craft treated planks, which can then make generators that passively make RF at no cost.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest78775CE815: With all your new-found knowledge of materials and alloys, you have managed to create a refined version of mechanical essence, worth even more EMC than its basic form.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest7C0D8A15D0: In order to use Create machines, you need to generate rotational force. There's a variety of ways to do this, each with their own advantages and disadvantages. You can learn more about each of them by searching them on JEI and holding "W".
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.quest9E7EB6E38E: With the mechanical mixer, you can automate shapeless crafting recipes, plus many other item/fluid recipes specific to the mixer.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.questB10D556104: With steel, you can craft the basic tier of mekanism logistic pipes, allowing you to transfer items, fluids, or energy in an easier manner.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.questD9714FC638: The time in a bottle can temporarily speed up blocks, how much you can speed things up is limited by how long you have had this item in your inventory.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.questF60C65F3D7: If you want to continue your path to automation, you will need to create new machines and alloys to help you.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_2.title: Tier 2: Create \& Immersive Engineering
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest182209ACB7: If you prefer AE2 over RS, there is a way.\nInscriber presses have a Create sequence assembly recipe.\nCraft a sky stone block with 8 polished deepslate (obtained deepslate from igneous extruder) and 1 yellow essence. You only need ONE. Then, cycle the block through a create millstone or crusher (it outputs itself as part of the recipe) and produce sky stone dust. Finally, wash the sky stone dust to obtain certus quartz, and welcome to AE2.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest18DF39CA83: With these items, you are now set for beginning with Refined Storage
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest1A67C9B9AB: By combining the power of the elements with the power of machinery, you managed to further enhance mechanical essences, making them much more powerful and with a much higer EMC value.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest1A983E23E6: The most essential Mekanism machine. With this, you will be able to craft increasingly powerful alloys and circuits in order to craft more advanced machines.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest1B6E93FE3C: In this modpack, you can craft special "effigies" that, when dropped, instantly summon their respective entity. This can be done both manually by right clicking the item or automatically with the click machine. They may require infusing with some specific liquids before fully awakening to their potential, though.
The most "magic" thing this modpack has
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest1D326E02F8: This one is a bit complicated: Craft Podzol either using slag and compost or in the metallurgic infuser and pulverize it to get mushrooms. Bulk haunt those mushrooms to get the nether mushrooms, which can be bone mealed in their respective nylium blocks to get the nether woods. (Nylium can be obtained through the philosopher's stone)
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest26BD8CE4BD: Whether you're playing on peaceful mode or just don't want to hurt innocent creatures, the sawmill can extract the materials directly from the effigies without spawning mobs, at the cost of potential efficiency.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest284F10C4BF: These generators consume items or fluids to generate RF, at the advantage of higher RF output and less variability. Hold SHIFT + N over these items for a basic description.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest36AF346F44: You may want amethyst to get into LazierAE2 and AE2Things later on. In order to get your first amethyst, you can combine 1 improved mechanical essence and 1 charged certus quartz in an induction smelter.\nThis is an expensive recipe and takes a lot of time and energy to complete, so once you have your first amethyst, you may prefer to dupe it. To do this, combine your amethyst shard with water in a crystalizer to get an amethyst cluster, which can be crushed for even more shards.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest3BBD496B7B: Both sulfur and nitrate can't be obtained through EMC means, so you will have to artificially synthesize them. Nitrate can be obtained by crushing sandstone, and sulfur can be obtained with oxygen and coal/charcoal in the PRC.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest3D8A15299F: You can upgrade every mechanism logistic pipe, allowing for greater throughput.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest3E46FBB082: The energized smelter can quickly smelt items at the cost of RF, and can be upgraded to smelt multiple items at a time.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest3F58AD4EAE: Craft an empty blaze burner then right click a blaze with it to obtain a blaze burner. The blaze burner goes below basins and can be fed fuel to provide heat needed for some mixing recipes.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest459286FB75: Many Mekanism machines can be upgraded with Tier Installers, which increase the amount of items that can be processed at once, making their overall speed much faster. However, some machines cannot be upgraded this way.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest511A43E028: With these items, you are now set for beginning your ME System
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest5328C8928A: Easily the most powerful RF transporting mod, flux networks lets you wirelessly transfer RF from inputs (flux plugs) into outputs (flux points), with no transfer limit.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest543452935C: You can insert up to 8 speed/energy upgrades into a Mekanism machine to increase their processing speed and energy efficiency, respectively. Some machines allow up to 8 gas upgrades which increase their gas consumption efficiency.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest550E4D68A9: You managed to create an improved version of your mechanical essence, but you feel it can still be made better, and you are going to find out how.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest5C667632EE: You can get ender pearls from transmuting iron.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest63F6066959: Thermal's highest tier of integral components.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest65CCE43B4B: After crafting your first flux block with a more expensive alternate recipe, you can get more flux indefinitely by throwing redstone dust on top of a flux block, placing a block of obsidian on top, and left clicking it with your hand. Only the obsidian is consumed
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest6BC0E03B21: Mekanism has its own generators to produce large amonuts of RF, however some of the most powerful ones aren't available to you yet.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest6E8F9BEE7C: Use the philosopher's stone to transmute oak logs into other logs, to decorate your base as you want.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest71C9474E4B: Mekanism is a powerful tech mod that adds tiered machines to help you with mass-production of many of the ingredients you will need to continue your journey.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest71D0B9CED0: You can get gunpowder by mixing charcoal, nitrate dust, and sulfur.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest725C03AFA4: These mekanism generators allow you to passively generate RF without any active material cost. However, their power output is usually variable and you may have to adjust for it with energy storage. Hold SHIFT + N over these items for a basic description.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest7B8B18695D: Further enhance a machine's base stats.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest7DAA376A57:
The quest icon shows a sink but you don't need it for infinite water.
Craft an evertide amulet and place it inside any mekanism fluid tank. Now all you need is to set the fluid tank to "empty" by clicking the *blue button*, and boom infinite water!

Warning, do *NOT* place the evertide amulet inside a rotary condensentrator, it will crash your game and corrupt your save!
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.quest936B0DE389: You can get lava from cobblestone or netherrack using the magma crucible.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.questA7E1E8B5F0: Place the click machine facing a wall to activate effigies. It doesnt use power, so set it to cick as fast as you want. Vacuumulators can easily pick up their loot, and RFTools timers can constantly activate droppers. This is just one way to do this, if you have another idea feel free to do it your way.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.questC2B0B4B953: No actual use, just nice for building.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_3.title: Tier 3: Basic Mekanism
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest13C6D580E3: Craft a blaze cake base and then fill it with lava using a spout to obtain a blaze cake, which can be fed to blaze burners to make them superheated, needed for some mixing recipes.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest157D4C0E9C: As it turns out, using refined fuel and infusing it with large amounts of energy is able to give the mechanical essence the power it needed to activate into it's full glory.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest158C15F8B1: When placed on a pedestal, drastically increases nearby machine's speed
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest174E355F55: So you saw how to get infinite water with the evertide amulet but you still want more? Fine, you may have the sink, now stop whining ;)
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest17DAE811CF: Works as slime balls in recipes and can be turned into crude oil at the magma crucible.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest1D17BB2C92: The transmutation interface is a useful block that lets your digital storage draw and insert items directly from your EMC table, making EMC links replacable by refined storage importers/exporters.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest1F4DCE63D7: Due to their internal RF transfer limit, Thermal machines usually don't behave when combined with tick accelerating like the watch of flowing time. The solution? Increase their transfer limit, of course! The ideal setup for a machine is one resonant integral component and three localized time destabilizer augments.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest26277A0FD5: Use your philosopher's stone to transmute several coal into a more dense fuel source.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest2B2DAA2647: The fission reactor is a large Mekanism multiblock which can burn fissile fuel to heat large amounts of water into steam. How do you build it? Idk, google it or look up a youtube tutorial. It does not, however, produce power by itself. Beware of nuclear meltdowns! Manage your nuclear waste properly and ensure that enough coolant (water) is available to the reactor at all times.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest2E769FE13E: The compression dynamo can burn liquids such as refined fuel into large amounts of RF.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest2FE7FB850D: Just as before, combine all the required ingredients in a superheated mixer and... wait, it's not done yet? It seems like it needs to be activated some way... Maybe that fission reactor can help?
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest3E8F024835: The Fissile Fuel production line can be complicated to understand just from JEI alone, but this quest tells you every machine required to produce fissile fuel, which only requires four raw ingredients: uranium, sulphur, fluorite, and water. Good luck!
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest4E81E76086: New tier, new materials; you know the deal already.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest56E72EB694: You can combine fissile fuel and fluorite dust in a purification chamber to obtain a fissile fuel pellet, useful for crafting the next tier of mechanical essences.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest593EEC1F5C: The steam turbine, another large multiblock, lets you use all that steam the fission reactor produces to generate power, and cools it down back to water which you can then feed back into the reactor. Caution: if the turbine's internal power buffer gets full, it will stop cooling down steam, which can result in a bad time if you depended on that steam being cooled for your reactor's coolant. Again, just search a tutorial on how to build a good turbine.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest6201AC6B56: The fractionating still can process crude oil into usable products, such as light/heavy oil.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest767667B65E: Use these wisely, no refunds. Alternatively, you may also bulk haunt dough to get eggs.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest7943076114: The refining process used to obtain refined fuel also gives additional bitumen, sulfur and tar as byproducts, making it especially useful.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.quest850DE0A329: Crush netherrack to obtain cinder flour.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.questB14BDB8AF4: Crafting ingredient for powerful ProjectE gadgets
ftbquests.chapter.tier_4.title: Tier 4: Advanced Mekanism
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest13: A unique superalloy, nearly 100%% inmune to any type of radiation.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest14: By fusing 1000 of each metal and gem together, I am able to create the ultimate singularity, containing every element necessary for the creation of the final star.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest1D: The true potential of the final star. With this, EMC and raw materials are something I shall never have to worry about again.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest2A: Infusing things with raw essence of darkness is inefficient, if I enrich it first I can extract *20 times* more darkness essence out of it.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest2D: There are multiple ways to summon the wither automatically, but one of the easiest is to use the wither builder. I just add the required items, and it will summon it automatically for me, which I can then kill with a mob crusher for automatic nether stars.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest38: A powerful star in and of itself, it serves as an ingredient for the most powerful star.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest41: When in direct sunlight, the solar neutron activator can turn nuclear waste from my fission reactor into polonium.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest4B: Use the Ether Gas to craft the highest tier machine frame.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest53: There it is. The most powerful star ever created. With the EMC this gives me I would be set for life. However, I can find better uses out of it.
By coating HPE sheets with this superalloy, I may be able to experiment with polonium and even antimatter production.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest54: Can set the heat level of blaze burners permanently and at no cost.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest59: Some say, this is what the emptyness of space is made of.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest5A: Trap a wither inside a stasis chamber and place a fluid laser base directly above it to passively obtain ether gas.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest64: Unlimited Power. Note: DO NOT Place the ultimate energy cube down in order to charge it, charge it either wirlessly or by putting it as an item in any charging machine, placing it down will make you the owner, and not recognize it for the crafting recipe.
READ QUEST FOR HOW TO CRAFT
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest6A: Although slow and expensive to obtain, this antimatter will certainly help me create stuff that would otherwise be physically impossible.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest6D: Not all creative items are needed for the creative vending upgrade, some are simply optional if you want to go after them or not.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest72: Infinite gas and chemical storage and withdrawal. Highly recommended to craft before final star, since it allows for infinite antimatter.
I can create skeleton skulls with some bone and a body stone, and infuse it with darkness essence to create wither skeleton skulls, which can be used to summon the wither.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest79: I understand everything now. The meaning behind all the crystals I have birthed into this universe. They were guiding me, slowly teaching me how to create stronger, more powerful catalysts, in order to achieve the final goal. The final star awaits me...
Store and retrieve items from the infinitely deep center of the final star. If you crafted this, congratulations, you win the modpack.
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.quest7C: No RF used, very fast processing
ftbquests.chapter.tier_5_endgaem.title: Tier 5: Endgame
